# Backups (cms-admin)

## Purpose

The client side of the owner-only backup download (D20): lists the dumps and asks for a one-minute presigned link after password plus 2FA. Used by the Backups page ([backups flow](../../flows/backups/FLOW.md)).

## Techniques

A feature module: an API factory registered through `Features.registry.ts` (`apiServices`), provided to pages by a React context; TanStack Query hooks for server data. The list never fetches on its own (the page's button calls `refetch`, because the server throttles the list per actor); a 4xx answer is final and only network and 5xx errors retry. The download link is a bearer URL: never stored, cached or logged.

## Technologies

Axios, TanStack Query.

## Entry points

`createBackupsApi`, `useBackupsQuery`, `useBackupsNavItems`, `isBackupsNotConfigured`, `isBackupsRateLimited`, `BackupsApiProvider` / `useBackupsApi`.

## Where to change what

A new backup call: `Backups.api.ts` plus a hook in `Backups.queries.ts`. Keep the link out of state and the query cache.
